payload.entry: LAND REVIEW (bob-cli-q5.5.1.land). Verified: all 6 phases closed; bob-cli ba21e4c2 contract + 70 SM vectors; bob-plugins 27157a49/72917260/514f7992/b7f17a51/73d028e5; marks.json byte-identical to bob-cli canonical; 53/53 snooze unit + e2e self-test pass at bob-plugins a4bd99f2; build:check clean; vault bob-ledger-tools main.js/styles.css/manifest byte-identical to a4bd99f2; no epic-symbols for q5.5.1 or q5.5. Integration (bob-cli, this turn): docs/snooze-marks.md JavaScript mirror now names the landed fragments/tests/e2e (plan-era wording removed), docs/today-marks.md notes the shared slot + Today toggle gating clocks, docs/plan.md Snoozed forecast links the plugin chip. REMAINING EPIC WORK (caused by definition-marks 27157a49, deployed): screenshots live-light/live-dark/hover show the definition clock time wrapping one digit per line in the fixed 1.2em inline-flex box and overlapping neighbouring lines; CSS tone selectors .bob-snooze-mark--asleep/--due/--blocked never match emitted classes --indigo/--amber/--muted so no state color paints; due clocks never show the visible '· due' word (element takes bare HH:MM, ::after shows only time); glyph is the color emoji with mask:none instead of the Lucide alarm-clock mask tinted currentColor (definition clock and woken pill). The e2e passed because it reads class names and data attributes, not rendered layout/computed color. Planned as a lander tale. FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: (1) vault-format.md 6030/6000 budget (q5.5.1.4 #1, .5 #1, .6 #2) -> +1 on existing bob-cli-oc; root cause ebc45fec (bob-cli-qm.7) already a DISCOVERED ISSUE on active epic bob-cli-qm; not caused by this epic. (3) Deploy-blocked notes (q5.5.1.2 #1, q5.5.1.3 #1) -> declined: resolved by q5.5.1.6 deploy, vault verified byte-identical. (4) ENOSPC /tmp (q5.5.1.2 #2) -> declined as a task: host hygiene, not repo code; /tmp (32G tmpfs) is again 100% full from ad-hoc agent acceptance clones (bob-settings-acceptance-* ~11G from 2026-11-25, bob-cli-*-q5-build ~6.6G); reported to Bryan for cleanup.
